description: Source code implementing Bluetooth Volume Offset Control Service (VOCS) for Zephyr OS, including GATT characteristic handlers, notifications, and service registration.

methods.name: offset_state_cfg_changed
methods.description: Handles configuration changes for the offset state characteristic.

methods.name: read_offset_state
methods.description: Reads the current offset state characteristic value.

methods.name: location_cfg_changed
methods.description: Handles configuration changes for the location characteristic.

methods.name: vocs_notify_str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the notification type.

methods.name: notify_work_reschedule
methods.description: Reschedules notification work with a specified delay.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends a GATT notification for a specified characteristic.

methods.name: notify_work_handler
methods.description: Handles scheduled notification work, sending notifications if needed.

methods.name: value_changed
methods.description: Triggers notification work for a specific notification type.

methods.name: write_location
methods.description: Handles write requests to the location characteristic.

methods.name: read_location
methods.description: Reads the current location characteristic value.

methods.name: write_vocs_control
methods.description: Handles write requests to the VOCS control characteristic.

methods.name: output_desc_cfg_changed
methods.description: Handles configuration changes for the output description characteristic.

methods.name: write_output_desc
methods.description: Handles write requests to the output description characteristic.

methods.name: vocs_write
methods.description: Helper function to perform write operations on VOCS characteristics.

methods.name: read_output_desc
methods.description: Reads the output description characteristic value.

methods.name: bt_vocs_free_instance_get
methods.description: Provides a free instance of the VOCS server.

methods.name: bt_vocs_svc_decl_get
methods.description: Retrieves the service declaration attributes for a VOCS instance.

methods.name: prepare_vocs_instances
methods.description: Initializes VOCS service instances.

methods.name: bt_vocs_register
methods.description: Registers a new VOCS instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: bt_vocs_state_get
methods.description: Gets the current state (offset) of the VOCS instance.

methods.name: bt_vocs_location_get
methods.description: Gets the current location of the VOCS instance.

methods.name: bt_vocs_location_set
methods.description: Sets the location of the VOCS instance.

methods.name: bt_vocs_state_set
methods.description: Sets the offset state of the VOCS instance.

methods.name: bt_vocs_description_get
methods.description: Gets the description string of the VOCS instance.

methods.name: bt_vocs_description_set
methods.description: Sets the description string of the VOCS instance.
